title: Beach
summary: “Focus and relax to the sound| of crashing waves...”

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Beach and Stony Shore.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Strength also counts as Psychic for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud-Slap, and Sand Tomb: 2× stronger.

Brine, Clangorous Soulblaze, Crabhammer, Hidden Power Water, Land's Wrath, Muddy Water, Razor Shell, Sandsear Storm, Scorching Sands, Shell Side Arm, Shell Trap, Smelling Salts, Strength, Surf, Thousand Waves, and Wave Crash: 1.5× stronger.
Aura Sphere, Focus Blast, Focus Punch, Stored Power, and Zen Headbutt: 1.3× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ground-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's accuracy.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: is pumped up (critical hits become likelier).
